description: This file defines the 'Process' class within the 'Thunder::Core' namespace, including nested 'Options' class, for managing process creation, control, and I/O operations across Windows and POSIX systems. It includes methods for launching, killing, waiting for processes, and handling process I/O streams, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: Class encapsulating process management, including launching, termination, and I/O handling, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Nested class within 'Process' for constructing command-line options and arguments for process execution.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks if the process is currently active/running.

methods.name: HasConnector
methods.description: Checks if the process has valid input/output handles.

methods.name: IsKilled
methods.description: Indicates if the process was killed.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Indicates if the process has terminated normally.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Writes data to the process input stream.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Reads data from the process output stream.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Reads data from the process error stream.

methods.name: Launch
methods.description: Starts the process with specified options and retrieves its process ID.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Terminates the process, optionally with a hard kill.

methods.name: WaitProcessCompleted
methods.description: Waits for the process to complete within a specified timeout.
